newsitem.title: UK: Albright Mexico unit to expand STTP capacity.
newsitem.headline: Albright Mexico unit to expand STTP capacity.

text.p: British chemicals group Albright & Wilson Plc said on Tuesday its 50-percent-owned Mexican unit would double its sodium tripolyphosphate (STTP) capacity at a plant in Veracruz.
The company said Albright & Wilson Troy de Mexico would increase capacity to 70,000 tonnes per year from 35,000 tonnes at a cost of about $5.0 million.
Modifications to the plant, located at Coatzacoalcos, Veracruz, would be completed by the end of the year.
The company said the market for STTP in Latin America was expected to grow by about 15 percent by 1999, representing an increase of 55,000 tonnes.
